## File: facebookresearch_sapiens/engine/mmengine/optim/scheduler/momentum_scheduler.py

Prompts

```
['build a ConstantMomentum scheduler to decay optimizer momentum by a constant factor until a milestone', 'build a CosineAnnealingMomentum scheduler to anneal optimizer momentum using a cosine schedule', 'build an ExponentialMomentum scheduler to decay optimizer momentum by gamma each epoch', 'build a LinearMomentum scheduler to linearly change the momentum multiplicative factor over epochs', 'build a ReduceOnPlateauMomentum scheduler to reduce momentum when a monitored metric stops improving', 'build a StepParamScheduler that decays optimizer param by gamma every step_size epochs', 'build a MultiStepParamScheduler that decays optimizer param by gamma at specified milestones', 'build a CosineAnnealingParamScheduler that anneals optimizer param using cosine schedule with T_max', 'build a OneCycleParamScheduler that cycles learning rate from initial to max and then to min', 'build a ReduceOnPlateauParamScheduler that reduces optimizer param when monitored metric stops improving']
```

Usage

```
{'build_constant_momentum_scheduler': 'build a ConstantMomentum scheduler to decay optimizer momentum by a constant factor until a milestone', 'build_cosine_annealing_momentum_scheduler': 'build a CosineAnnealingMomentum scheduler to anneal optimizer momentum using a cosine schedule', 'build_exponential_momentum_scheduler': 'build an ExponentialMomentum scheduler to decay optimizer momentum by gamma each epoch', 'build_linear_momentum_scheduler': 'build a LinearMomentum scheduler to linearly change the momentum multiplicative factor over epochs', 'build_reduce_on_plateau_momentum_scheduler': 'build a ReduceOnPlateauMomentum scheduler to reduce momentum when a monitored metric stops improving'}
```
